column5: The shear moduli are not audio-band (ultrasonic moduli exceed static ones) and the single tree is not the violin's wood. A violin-grade (curly, resonance) maple of the committed Spycher pack has E_L about 9700 to 10000 MPa and E_R about 1650 to 1700 MPa dynamically: carry that as the sensitivity. Axis convention: material axis 1 = L (grain), axis 2 = R (across the growth rings, in the plane of a quartersawn plate), thickness = T, so shear_modulus_12 = G_LR, shear_modulus_13 = G_LT and shear_modulus_23 = G_RT, poisson_ratio_12 = nu_LR (strain along R per strain along L under stress along L; the source's subscripts were converted to this order in the committed Sonderegger pack). The validity band omega 0 to 2 pi 2000 rad/s and T 280 to 320 K is the band in which this use is DECLARED by the pack author, not a measured band.
